headline_item.title_zh: Rapidus两纳米芯片量产恐难产
headline_item.title_en: Sources: Rapidus has yet to produce functioning SRAM, a key step that needed to be completed by summer 2026 to meet its March 2028 deadline for making 2nm chips (Takashi Mochizuki/Bloomberg)
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 日本政府扶持的芯片厂商Rapidus在SRAM制造进度上严重滞后，恐危及2028年实现2纳米芯片量产的目标
headline_item.event_summary_en: Rapidus, a state-backed Japanese chip startup, has failed to produce functional SRAM, a critical step for its 2nm manufacturing roadmap. To meet the aggressive March 2028 mass production deadline, the company was required to finalize this stage by summer 2026.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】日本芯片初创公司Rapidus在半导体先进制程研发中心：未能生产出可正常运行的SRAM样品，导致量产进度延宕
【起因与机理】为实现2028年大规模生产2纳米芯片的宏大国家目标，SRAM是必经的技术门槛
【关键技术规格】日本政府重点扶持芯片公司Rapidus。
【观点态度】面临2026年夏度的技术关键节点大考。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Japanese chip startup Rapidus: Failed to produce functional SRAM, threatening its mass production schedule
[Root Cause & Mechanism] The component is essential for meeting the national goal of 2nm chip production by 2028
[Perspective & Impact] Critical technical milestone due by summer 2026.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: Rapidus的量产路正如其名字一样——“急行军”变成了原地踏步。国家队拿着巨额补贴却连SRAM这种地基都没打好，这是想用情怀去跟台积电拼良率吗？
headline_item.industry_impact_en: Rapidus is living up to its name—in reverse. Throwing national subsidies at the wall won't magically make 2nm logic work if you can't even nail the basic SRAM; physics doesn't care about your government's deadlines.

headlines.title_zh: 华裔女商被指在美充当中国间谍
headlines.title_en: A profile of Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy who founded Megaspeed with her business partner Kang Wei, who sources say was often introduced as her husband (New York Times)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国情报机构指认Alice Huang为中国情报人员，其与合作伙伴Kang Wei共同创立科技公司Megaspeed
headlines.event_summary_en: U.S. intelligence officials have identified Alice Huang as a Chinese asset. Together with her partner Kang Wei, often introduced as her husband, she co-founded the tech firm Megaspeed, leveraging business operations to allegedly conduct intelligence activities.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】黄爱丽、康伟在美国科技商业领域：被指认为中国情报资产，并创立科技公司Megaspeed
【起因与机理】涉嫌利用商业身份从事敏感的情报获取与渗透活动
【关键技术规格】Alice Huang及其合伙人康伟被情报机构锁定。
【观点态度】事件反映了美方针对科技背景人员的情报审查力度升级。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Alice Huang and Kang Wei (U.S. tech and business sector): Identified as Chinese intelligence assets; co-founders of Megaspeed
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Alleged use of commercial cover for intelligence gathering and infiltration
[Key Specification] Alice Huang and partner Kang Wei identified by intelligence agencies.
[Perspective & Impact] Highlights the intensifying scrutiny of tech-sector actors by U.S. authorities.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 科技创业圈又多了个碟战剧本，把老公当“挡箭牌”合伙创业确实是高级配置。这年头搞BP不仅要懂技术，还得防着不仅要你的天使轮，还要你的保密协议。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Another spy thriller script in the startup world, where using your 'husband' as a business partner is clearly the ultimate strategic pivot. These days, founders need to be careful—your investors might not just be looking for a seat on the board, but for a seat in your secure server room.

headlines.title_zh: 被美国拉黑的中国高校买入英伟达顶级芯片
headlines.title_en: Records show China's Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close PLA ties, has access to Nvidia H200 AI chips despite being on a US export blacklist (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)
headlines.event_summary_zh: 西北工业大学虽身处美国出口黑名单，却仍通过第三方渠道采购到了英伟达高性能H200 AI芯片
headlines.event_summary_en: Northwestern Polytechnical University in China has reportedly procured Nvidia H200 AI chips via intermediaries, despite being on the US Entity List due to its military ties. This reveals significant gaps in global supply chain enforcement despite stringent export controls.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】西北工业大学在中国：绕过美方出口管制获取英伟达H200高性能AI芯片
【起因与机理】作为军工科研重点高校，其核心算力需求受制裁但仍需维持高水平技术研发
【关键技术规格】西北工业大学通过中间商获取高端芯片。
【观点态度】供应链分销复杂性导致制裁执行面临巨大挑战。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Northwestern Polytechnical University (NPU) (China): Procured high-performance Nvidia H200 chips through third-party channels despite US sanctions
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Urgent need for high-end computing power for military-linked R&D despite export restrictions
[Key Specification] NPU acquired high-end chips through middlemen.
[Perspective & Impact] Supply chain complexity undermines enforcement efficacy.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 看来所谓的‘全球最严出口管制’，在万能的中间商和层层转包的订单面前，更像是一场昂贵的表演。英伟达的芯片是真香，至于禁令？那不过是让这块芯片多走了几趟‘旅游线路’，顺便加了个涨价百分之百的过路费。
headlines.industry_impact_en: It seems the 'strictest export control' is more of an expensive performance when faced with creative middlemen and tiered sub-contracts. Nvidia's chips are just too good to miss; the sanctions merely forced them to take a scenic route with a 100% markup.

人们应该始终掌控未来。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.
